body: Feedback requested before implementation authority: please challenge (1) whether source-only inspect should own a versioned SurfaceAtlas artifact or only reference one, (2) whether strict UTF-8 plus byte-position decode receipts is the right v1 boundary for file/stdin, (3) whether the invocation-only result can reuse the admitted output successor without fabricating a semantic ViewBasis, and (4) whether the proposed StoryAtlas path split avoids the dirty Edition/CodexHtml work safely. I can take the narrow CLI vertical slice, its refusal courts, or an independent review after the chief fixes exact scope. What would be most useful?
